pt_freewind_hide: Moonfeather, tanner. My bench is in the middle of the Post, north side. Hide, leather, cloth, and the meat off the same carcass - pay once and I teach the lot, cooking included. Everything I work was carried up the ramp dead or walked up it alive, and I can tell you which by the smell.
pt_freewind_wood: I teach woodwork in the middle of the Post. Yes - Bloodhoof. A cousin, far enough off that it did me no good. We work aspen now, off a mountain that was not there. Gohn's bench on the south side is where the milling is done.
pt_freewind_essence: Nara. They call me Tinker, which among tauren is not yet a compliment. I work on the west side of the Post. Metal, a crystal out of a vein, and a steady hand. Somebody has to understand the winches before the next one fails.
ct_freewind: Sunwalker. I train every discipline, beside the inn. I taught on Thunder Bluff. I teach here. The students are the same and the view is worse. Show me where you are, and bring coin.
ak_freewind: Tahu Stonehorn, Artifact Keeper. I stand south of the inn. The same hands made every version of your set. Leave the piece with me and take the one that suits how you fight now. No charge. Keepers do not sell - not on the Bluff, and not here.
pt_freewind_forge: Kaga. Mining and smithing, both halves or neither. I teach in the middle of the Post. There is no forge on this rock - the council will not have a furnace on a top held up by rope - so you learn here and carry your ore to one.
pt_freewind_herbs: Greyhoof, apothecary. South-west of the inn. Every weed is a medicine to someone. Nothing grows up here, so everything I teach you about is down on the floor or up in the aspen. I will show you which to pull, and what to do with it after.
fw_banker: MerchantTusk. Dis be de bank, west side of de Post, up on dis big rock wit' all de cows. Dere is only one bank, mon, and dere is only one me, and I did not walk up dat ramp. Do not ask how dat works. Hand me ya things and go be a hero.
